name: Foundry: Cascade
design_intent:
FOUNDRY: CASCADE — THE FOUNDRY circuit's VERTICAL collapsing-shaft finale (tier 3; brawl_arena_expansion_2026-07-19 Foundry row 16). A walled molten shaft of four zigzag destructible tiers that erode BOTTOM-UP — the base melts first and the collapse front races UPWARD, forcing a climb toward the open top until the last tier goes and everyone is airborne over the void. Last one still flying wins. The vertical member of the collapse-finale family (foundry_meltdown center-out, meltdown_box outer-in, foundry_collapse_ring radial, THIS vertical). NON-lethal bumper walls seal the sides (a sideways knock ricochets back into the shaft); the top is OPEN (no lethal lid) and the void is below. Tier 3.

FANTASY: 'the floor melts up under you — keep climbing and be the last one flying.' Fair because every tier erodes on the SAME telegraphed schedule for everyone; the void is the shared killer, the jetpack climb the shared escape.

HOW IT'S BUILT (destructible_block only, no new mechanic): four trampoline destructible tiers zigzag up the shaft and erode bottom-up: T1 base (top1400) break t3.0; T2 (top900) break t5.0; T3 (top400) break t7.0; T4 top (top-100) break t9.0 (last). Each telegraphs its break with growing CRACKS + a SHUDDER + a hazard-red flash for telegraph_s 1.0s BEFORE it vanishes, so you SEE the floor melt up and climb ahead of it. LEFT + RIGHT vertical BUMPER walls (inner faces x0 / x1600, restitution 0.86) seal the shaft sides NON-lethally so all lethality is the bottom void. KILL IDENTITY: a fall into the void = off-screen ring-out via kill(&ring_out); a rival smashed off within the 6.0s window is credited, a pure ran-out-of-floor fall is an uncredited self-fall (killer=-1). QA NOTE: expect a HIGH uncredited-self-fall share on this collapse archetype BY DESIGN (judge vs the meltdown note, not the standard >=88%).

GEOMETRY (walled vertical SHAFT, inner faces x0..x1600): T1 x540..1060 top1400 (base, over the void) / T2 x870..1330 top900 / T3 x270..730 top400 / T4 x570..1030 top-100 (top). LEFT bumper wall x-100..0 and RIGHT x1600..1700 (y-100..1620) seal the sides. ONE full-shaft-width void under the base (rim y1560). Bounds left -500 / right 2100 (OUTSIDE the bumper walls as failsafes — the walls stop side ring-outs first), TOP -2750 (OPEN, full clearance above T4 -> no lethal lid, unlike the_ascent), bottom 2200 (>=672px recovery sky under the base). Molten open_sky (clouds off, horizon glow).

MOVEMENT-TOOL-PER-GAP (flight-required; Tuning: trampoline apex 270px; max spring drift ~527px; normal_boost_max 760 + accel 4600 > gravity 1600 => sustained climb; super rises ~2450px). Required traversal is entirely VERTICAL CLIMBS, each a 500px rise (all tiers trampoline, apex only 270px):
- CLIMB T1->T2 (top1400 -> top900 = 500px up, +300 horizontal): > 480 spring apex and >> 270 trampoline. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED; an under-shot drops into the void. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB T2->T3 (top900 -> top400 = 500px up, ~600 horizontal): JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB T3->T4 (top400 -> top-100 = 500px up): JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY (a super earns the top fast).
- Every tier-to-tier rise (500px) exceeds the 480px spring apex and all tiers are trampoline (apex 270), so zero-boost reaches NO tier above it — you climb the shaft ONLY on the jetpack; a bumper wall reflects, it does not lift. As the shaft erodes bottom-up the climb is forced; last one flying wins. Vertical distance is the entire level.
- RECOVER: a sideways knock RICOCHETS off a bumper wall back into the shaft (non-lethal); the drop from the base bottom (1528) to the bottom blast line (2200) is 672px of open sky over the void, so a fuelled player can boost to catch a surviving tier. Verb: FLY.

SIGNATURE / DISTINCT: the only VERTICAL collapse finale (a bottom-up melt forcing a climb, vs the horizontal/radial melts). One-line read: 'the shaft melts up under you — climb ahead of the collapse and be the last one flying.'
